cases.row: Effects: every EFFECT_CATALOG kind (effect layers, schema v13)
cases.description: One effect layer per render kind (41), in sequence over a picture.

cases.row: Effects: effect layer between picture tracks
cases.description: An adjustment lane between two pictures (the export applies it to the finished frame).

cases.row: Effects: every EFFECT_CATALOG kind limited by a frame-space mask (MK5.2)
cases.description: The same layer per render kind, each limited by a mask on the adjustment lane: the kinds rotate through a hard rectangle, a feathered ellipse, an ellipse minus a rectangle, and a keyframed rectangle that crosses the frame, so every kind is exercised with a hard edge, a soft edge, a combine and motion.

cases.row: Effects: an adjustment lane's frame-space mask stays fixed over a moving picture (MK9.1)
cases.description: A blur lane limited to a path minus an inverted split, drawn in frame pixels, over a clip that slides and scales under it; a second lane grades inside a keyframed ellipse.
